results.title: Press Release: Cinven, International private equity firm, to acquire Salsify, Inc.
highlights:
Press Release: Cinven, International private equity firm, to acquire Salsify, Inc.
...
BOSTON – July 22, 2026 – International private equity firm, Cinven, today announces that it has agreed to acquire Salsify, Inc. (‘the Company’ or ‘Salsify’), a leading cloud-native provider of Product Experience Management (‘PXM’) software solutions. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

results.title: Goodwin Advises Salsify on Acquisition by Cinven | News & Events | Goodwin
highlights:
Goodwin Advises Salsify on Acquisition by Cinven
...
The Technology and M&A teams advised Salsify, a leading cloud-native provider of Product Experience Management (PXM) software solutions, on its agreement to be acquired by international private equity firm Cinven. The acquisition reflects Cinven’s conviction in Salsify’s growth potential and its differentiated PXM platform, which helps brands manage and syndicate product information across thousands of digital commerce destinations.

results.title: Salsify Exits to Cinven for ~$1B: Why This Is a Win for SaaS and SAP's Loss
results.author: Ayelet & Christian
highlights:
On July 22nd, Salsify, the Boston-based product experience management platform, announced it’s being acquired by Cinven, a European PE firm with roughly $50 billion in assets under management. The deal is signed and pending closing, subject to regulatory approval.
...
The terms are not public, management announced the deal to hundreds of employees on Wednesday morning, and the number circulating in the employee alumni network is approximately a $1 billion all-cash deal. If that’s accurate it’s roughly a 50% haircut to Salsify’s 2022 Series F mark, when TPG and Primera invested at about $27 a share at a $2bn valuation. Depending on the deal waterfall, that could mean roughly $13-14 per share to shareholders at closing.

results.title: Salsify acquisition of Alkemics
results.author: Salsify, Inc
highlights:
Salsify acquired Alkemics and its Supplier Experience Management (SupplierXM) platform on May 19th. Based in Paris, France and founded in 2011 by Antoine Durieux, Antoine Perrin, and Benoît Portoleau-Balloy, Alkemics is a collaborative commerce platform for retailers and distributors. The combined capabilities make the Salsify Commerce Experience Management platform (CommerceXM) the only continuously adaptive system of record and workflow for brands and retailers to collaborate on winning product experiences for the digital shelf.
...
This transaction is a private transaction and the terms will not be disclosed. The combined company will cross $100M ARR by mid-2021 and has offices in Boston, Lisbon, and Paris.
